paragraphs: A cloud coding harness. Clone a GitHub repository into a container, run it, point an AI agent at it, watch the diff, commit, and publish a shareable live preview — all from the browser.
Built for HTML, PHP, Laravel, React (Vite), and Next.js. Deployed on a Dokploy VPS.

Status: Phase 1 of 8. The event-sourced server, wire protocol, database, authentication, and web shell are built and verified. Containers, the routing gateway, the agent, and previews are specified but not yet implemented — see Current status. The architecture and remaining phases are in documentation/plan.md.
features: Previewing your work on UCCH itself — that's the local run above.
The live preview (p{port}-{hash}.ucch.danialirfan.dev) of a dev server you started in a project's terminal — described above, and working.

requirements.text: Every account gets a "Personal" workspace on first sign-in, so the switcher is never empty.

Browse — researchbrowse is a Browser Use agent, a model driving a real browser. researchread escalates to it on its own when the crawler hits a bot check, a login wall or a 403, and the model can send it directly to a page that needs clicking through.
